Good to know

A few helpful answers.

Have a more specific question? We are happy to talk about an individual piece.

What do you offer?

Raw gems and mineral specimens, loose gemstones and finished luxury jewelry.

Where are you based?

Salt Lake City, Utah. You can also find upcoming vendor appearances on our Events page.

How do you source pieces?

We source directly and through reputable sources. Ask us what sourcing information is available for the specific piece you are considering.

Are the pictured pieces available?

Availability is specific to each piece. Collection previews are examples, not confirmed live inventory. Contact us to confirm a piece’s current status.

Can I request more photographs or documentation?

Yes. Contact us with the name of the piece and tell us which views or information would help you decide.

Can I buy online?

Where an item has a Buy securely link, it takes you to our payment provider. Otherwise, contact us to confirm availability, price and purchase arrangements.

What should I confirm before buying?

Confirm the description, dimensions, known treatments, condition, documentation, total price, delivery arrangements and return terms for your specific purchase.
